content.value_statement: Building Claude Code extensions can require repeated scaffold decisions. This skill provides reusable templates for agents, skills, commands, and hook scripts.
actual_capabilities: Provides a guide for choosing agent, skill, command, and hook templates.
Includes Markdown templates for custom agents, skills, and slash commands.
Includes a bash hook scaffold with JSON parsing, logging, and blocking examples.
Shows copy commands for installing templates under Claude Code directories.
Links to Claude Code and Agent Skills documentation for further reference.
limitations: Templates require manual customization before use.
The hook scaffold depends on jq when executed.
It does not generate finished extension code automatically.
It assumes Claude Code paths such as ~/.claude and .claude.

use_cases.title: Scaffold a Custom Skill
use_cases.description: Start from a SKILL.md template and replace placeholders with project-specific instructions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Commands
use_cases.description: Create consistent slash command documents with usage, flow, options, and expected output.

use_cases.title: Prototype Hook Automation
use_cases.description: Use the hook script scaffold to test JSON parsing, logging, and blocking behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a custom expert agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create an agent template for a [technology] expert. Include focus areas, principles, deliverables, and references.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Custom Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for a reusable Claude Code skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a skill template for [workflow]. Include trigger keywords, commands, examples, troubleshooting, and related resources.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Slash Command
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate command design for repeated team workflows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a slash command for [task]. Include usage, execution flow, options, examples, and output expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Validated Hook
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced automation with safety checks before enabling a hook.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to adapt the hook template for [event]. Include input validation, safe logging, blocking rules, and test cases before activation.

output_examples.input: Request: Create a React expert agent scaffold.
output: A named agent outline with React focus areas and quality principles.
A checklist covering testing, performance, and documentation expectations.
A references section ready for official React and tooling links.

output_examples.input: Request: Plan a slash command for release checks.
output_examples.output: A command outline with usage, execution flow, options, examples, and expected release validation results.

output_examples.input: Request: Adapt the hook script for write validation.
output_examples.output: A hook design summary covering JSON validation, allowed file paths, local logging, blocking behavior, and manual test steps.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder before installing a generated template.
Review hook behavior and log contents before enabling it in a project.
Keep extension files focused and move long details into reference files.
anti_patterns: Do not publish templates with unchanged placeholder text.
Do not enable hooks before reviewing command and file path checks.
Do not treat scaffolds as complete validation or security controls.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It provides templates for Claude Code agents, skills, slash commands, and hook scripts.

faq.question: Does it install extensions automatically?
faq.answer: No. It shows template locations and copy commands that users run manually.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex can read the templates and help adapt them for compatible extension workflows.

faq.question: What tools does the hook template need?
faq.answer: The hook script uses bash and jq when executed.

faq.question: Are the templates complete production extensions?
faq.answer: No. They are starting points that require names, descriptions, examples, and validation rules.

faq.question: Where are the templates stored?
faq.answer: The skill stores reusable template files in its assets directory.
